notablePrerequisites:
Nissa has at least 6 loyalty counters.
You control at least four lands.
description:
Activate Nissa's -5 to put Felidar Guardian onto the battlefield from the graveyard.
Using its ETB blink Nissa and a land.
Nissa and the land both enter putting 2 loyalty counters on Nissa.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Ashnod's Altar for {2}.
Repeat.
